Identity Theft

Doopliss (Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door) can steal another person's identity, including their appearance and name.

Power/Ability to:

Steal identities.
"So, you figured it out by now, right, Slick? Your body and name belong to me now!"
― Doopliss to Mario (Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door)

The ability to steal the identity of another person. Sub-power of Identity Manipulation.

Contents

  • 1 Also Called
  • 2 Capabilities
  • 3 Associations
  • 4 Limitations
  • 5 Known Users

Also Called[]

  • Identity Thievery

Capabilities[]

The user can steal someone else's identity, becoming that person and discarding their former one or giving it away to another. The user rearranges the target's records, even that person's entire existence can be affected to gain access to the target's assets and/or replace that person from the memories of their friends and family, inducing Mental Nonexistence to the victim. The user may also gain the person's appearance and/or abilities in the process.

Associations[]

  • Existence Manipulation
  • Life Replacement
  • Memory Manipulation
  • Name Severing
  • Reality Warping
  • Self-Existence Manipulation
  • Talent Theft
  • True Name Manipulation

Limitations[]

  • May need to know the target's identity before stealing it.
  • Target may suffer from Identity Erasure.
  • Users of Singularity cannot be copied.
  • Users of Omni Identity are immune.

Gallery[]

Ursula (The Little Mermaid)
Irene Belserion (Fairy Tail) enchants herself into Wendy, stating that it is more than possession, she had become "Wendy Belserion".
Shana (Shakugan no Shana) was able to absorb the remaining essence of Yukari Hirai, allowing her to assume her existence and identity but without changing her actual form or appearance.
After the defeat of Coronzon, Imagine Breaker manifested in the form of Kamijou Touma (Emanation) (Toaru Majutsu no Index), in addition of having Imagine Breaker he also has all of the original Kamijou Touma lost memories, this individual attempted to usurp Touma's identity, taking most of Imagine Breaker and his other powers with it.
The Night-folk (Deep Sleep Series) are consciousness lost in the realm of dreams, without a body to return to. They can steal the identity of lucid dreamers and coma patients, leaving them as Night-folk too.
Doug Shablowski (Regular Show)
Lola Lola (Cam) stole Alice Ackerman’s identity.
Eobard Thawne (Arrowverse) stole Harrison Well’s identity after killing both him and his wife.
